verdict.rationale: The evidence documents access to raw transaction history and a transaction-refresh webhook. Nothing in the pack shows Stripe enriching transactions with cleaned merchant names, categories, or logos. The 'agent-powered spending analysis' use case is an adjacent feature, not documented enrichment of transaction data.

support.subject: As a developer, raw bank transactions come back enriched — cleaned merchant names, categories, and logos — documented as a capability of the platform, not left as an exercise for me
